title: Asset findings backfill for the lead receipts of 23-28 September
method: A script extracted (asset path, sha256) candidates and data/*.json mentions from each of the 92 lead and audit receipts.
Six GPT-6 Sol workers (batches of 14-20 receipts grouped by topic) indexed what each receipt claims: assets with a recorded hash, and site pointers; they did not decode game data.
Batches B2-B5 first compared Sol high (B2, B4) with Sol medium (B3, B5), each carrying the L17 known-answer control; B1 and B6 then ran at medium.

Fragments were validated against the record schema and the receipt text (each sha256 and path must be recorded in the receipt), then merged into records-legacy.json; generated asset-findings.json grew from 547 to 828 findings (465 to 578 assets).
control: L17 (five assets with their sha256 values plus data/attachments.json:/ERGOS/[id=match_trigger]/noEffect): 5/5 and the pointer in all four workers that carried it (B2, B3, B4, B5).
limits: Receipts that record no per-asset hash (whole-root scans such as L23, L25, L34, L36, L43) contribute no asset findings; their leads stay findable through lead-index.json.
The L107 receipt contributes precision-recheck samples as asset findings; they say a sample operand was rechecked, not what it means.
Findings state what the receipt claims for the stated question; they are not new source verification.

leads.title: Backfill asset findings
leads.summary: The per-asset index now covers the lead and audit receipts of 24-28 September (92 read, 67 with asset findings): 281 asset findings (547 to 828 in the generated asset-findings.json, 465 to 578 assets) and 309 site pointers merged into records-legacy.json. Six Sol batches, checked against the L17 known-answer control and the record schema.
leads.reopenWhen: Receipts that record no per-asset hash stay unindexed at asset level (whole-root scans such as L23, L25, L34, L36); index them when a lead touches those assets.
